generator: tools/vep-storable-to-json over the Ensembl Metazoa release 63 PpapI1 cache; a survey of the converted cache's sequences, every one an unplaced scaffold, which chose the five scaffolds holding the most coding transcripts (JH660959.1, JH660960.1, JH660950.1, JH660949.1 and JH660948.1: 355 coding transcripts, 163 on the forward strand and 192 on the reverse) and the first and the last sequence of the cache's order that hold a transcript (AJVK01020912.1 and JH667840.1); the genome sequence of the seven from Phlebotomus_papatasi.PpapI1.dna.toplevel.fa.gz of Ensembl Metazoa release 63, the file checked against the directory's CHECKSUMS; tools/vep-seeded-variants --seed 1 --records wide --fasta <genome> --sequence <each of the seven> (generator version 3; 247 records, twelve a situation and fewer where the seven sequences give fewer places) and 300 single-base substitutions sampled with seed 1 from the cache's known variants on those sequences, each with the genome's base as its reference allele; Ensembl VEP over the two inputs under the default flags with --fasta <genome>; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 63 --assembly PpapI1 --species phlebotomus_papatasi --dataset wide=<reference>=<the seeded records> --dataset known=<reference>=<the known variants> --k 2 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, stop_gained, missense_variant, synonymous_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant> --focus-k 6 --include <every seeded record and sixty of the sampled known variants, evenly spaced> --covers species-phlebotomus-ppapi1 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --flank 5000 --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except <the transcripts on which a record changes one residue, the rows SIFT scores> --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 63 --variations <converted cache>/variations; scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <genome> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000 over the corpus with each record's sequence written by the cache's name; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs-sift); scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field HGVS_OFFSET for the everything set and the same with --field SIFT for the hgvs-sift set)

pruned_cache.variation_slices: the known variants within one base of a record under variations/<chr>/all_vars.gz with its .csi, as the Ensembl VEP cache lays them out; a sequence with no known variant beside a record carries the empty indexed file
